## Very rude and misleading
There was a jacket on the website discounted for a good price. I contacted customer support and they promised to honour the discount if I chose to purchase (as I was undecided on size). When I sent screenshots they said it was a bug on the website and that they will not honour it. And when I asked about any compensation for my time, they rudely asked about my hourly wage and how much they’d need to compensate it for , after back tracking and claiming they didn’t realise it’s rude due to English being their second language.  
  
I have also realised they hide tarrif fees, and include the time items take in customs to refund dates, to misleadingly cheat you out of your money.  
  
DO NOT USE.
